name: require-bindings-read-one-way
description: Every reader of a require binding reads the require one way: the require Node's createRequire returns is the platform's whether the script calls createRequire as a name or as a member and however many names hold it in turn, so a build script runs esbuild through it and a file starts Node's Worker through it, while a call through names that hold only each other runs nothing, and a Worker the file's own require returns starts no thread.
